title: Reports
intro: Pick a period, create a booking and earnings report for your shop and download it.

form.hint: A report can cover up to {{max}} days, ending today at the latest.

errors.order: The last day cannot be before the first day.
errors.future: The last day cannot be after today.
errors.tooLong: Choose a period of {{max}} days or less.

result.idle: Your report will show up here.
result.title: Report: {{from}} to {{to}}
result.emptyText: There were no bookings on these days. Try a longer period.
result.rule: Earnings are the total price of finished bookings after offers. Cancelled, missed and unfinished bookings earn nothing.
result.discounts: Offers took {{amount}} off the finished bookings.
result.open: {{number}} booking(s) today are not finished yet.
result.errorText: Something went wrong. Please try again.

byService.title: By service
byService.hint: Finished bookings only. Amounts are the service prices before offers.
byService.emptyText: Services of finished bookings will show up here.

toast.downloadFailed: Could not download the report. Please try again.
